NVJOLANG 1: First quarter of a three-quarter beginning sequence. Distance learning combined with periodic on-site instruction, conducted primarily in Navajo. Course emphasizes developing effective communication at a basic level, covering grammatical structures, vocabulary, and sentence patterns through speaking, reading, writing, and listening in everyday situations.Navajo culture.
NVJOLANG 2: Continuation of NVJOLANG 1. Distance learning combined with periodic on-site instruction, conducted primarily in Navajo. Course emphasizes developing effective communication at a basic level, covering grammatical structures, vocabulary, and sentence patterns through speaking, reading, writing, and listening in everyday situations.Navajo culture. Prerequisite: NVJOLANG 1 or consent of instructor.
NVJOLANG 3: Continuation of NVJOLANG 2. Distance learning combined with periodic on-site instruction, conducted primarily in Navajo. Course emphasizes further developing effective communication at a basic level, covering grammatical structures, vocabulary, and sentence patterns through speaking, reading, writing, and listening in everyday situations. Navajo culture. Prerequisite: NVJOLANG 2 or consent of instructor. Completion of NVJOLANG 3 fulfills the University Foreign Language Requirement.
NVJOLANG 21: The Second-year first quarter Navajo course requires completion of the First year sequence. Students engage in meaningful intercultural communication in a variety of contexts using socially and culturally appropriate forms. Prerequisite: Placement test
NVJOLANG 23: Second-Year Navajo - third in series with NVJOLANG 21 and 22.
NVJOLANG 395: Prerequisite: For Grad Students Only and Consent of Instructor
